key.name: tray-pos
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear in Gnome tray

key.name: tray-order
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear among other trays

key.name: custom-icons
key.description: Replace any icons with custom icons from themes

key.name: tray-grid-enabled
key.description: Show indicator icons in a grid opened from a single top-bar button. While this is off, each icon is shown in the top bar.

key.name: tray-grid-columns
key.description: Number of columns used to lay out icons inside the tray popup.

key.name: tray-grid-pinned
key.description: Unique ids of indicators that stay in the top bar while the popup grid is enabled.

key.name: tray-grid-known
key.description: Pairs of indicator id and label seen while the extension is running. Preferences uses this list to offer pin switches. The extension updates it automatically.
